_comment: Embedding model used to build the FAISS index and run searches. Changing this requires a full cache rebuild. Available locally-cached models are listed below.

available_models.name: paraphrase-MiniLM-L3-v2
available_models.notes: Original model. Fast, low-memory. Paraphrase-focused — conflates directional/geographic prefixes (Northwest vs Southwest).

available_models.name: all-MiniLM-L6-v2
available_models.notes: General-purpose 6-layer MiniLM. Better token resolution than L3. Locally cached.

available_models.name: all-mpnet-base-v2
available_models.notes: Recommended. MPNet 12-layer — preserves specific word distinctions within similar phrases. Better directional/geographic disambiguation.
